brock_yokley: Clement "Saint" Yokley was a tailor in Esterhaus until the posters went up. He came to R-F11 with a stub of a pencil, and within a day the whole bay knew that he counts everything: steps, shells, stars.
The colonel shook hands with the first hundred, one by one. Clement "Saint" Yokley was number 35. He still remembers how cold the colonel's glove was.
The report confirmed the Concord victory at Verdel Ridge. Clement "Saint" Yokley folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.

Clement "Saint" Yokley raised his head for a heartbeat too long at R-F11. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Valentin "Crow" Hodnepijumal of the Hegemony (@hodnepijumaloctu).
Clement "Saint" Yokley no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt.

The parcel for Clement "Saint" Yokley contained six left socks. By supper, he had found three men willing to trade. After the loss of Hill 304, Clement "Saint" Yokley helped stack spare sandbags at R-F11. Nobody asked when they would be needed.
Clement "Saint" Yokley has learned to recognize the ration cart by its squeaky wheel. This afternoon, a different squeak caused real disappointment.
ebrrrvole: Jakub Ebrrrvole signed the papers with a steady hand. The trench at R-F15 took him in like it takes everyone: without a word.
The colonel shook hands with the first hundred, one by one. Jakub Ebrrrvole was number 65. He still remembers how cold the colonel's glove was.
Konrad Jngaf repaired the strap on Jakub Ebrrrvole's pack. Payment was a biscuit and a promise to stop mentioning the haircut.

Jakub Ebrrrvole received a photograph taken outside the family home. He studied the unfamiliar curtains longer than the faces. The Concord hold Verdel Ridge now, and they can see straight into R-F15. Jakub Ebrrrvole has learned to walk bent double.
Somebody hung a doorbell on the next dugout. Jakub Ebrrrvole went to look. It was a spoon tied to an empty tin.
A bullet clipped Jakub Ebrrrvole's helmet at R-F15 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Gideon Actioncam of the Concord (@actioncam3000).

Fever took hold of Jakub Ebrrrvole overnight. The medics changed the dressing twice and then called for the bearers. Hill 304 fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Jakub Ebrrrvole helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.
Jakub Ebrrrvole did not last the night outside the full aid post. The bearers who carried him in carried him out again at dawn.
Another member of the House of Ebrrrvole reached the line: Bastian Ebrrrvole. He asked where Jakub Ebrrrvole had slept, then chose a different corner.
jackmdunn06: Isidor Jackmdunn came up the line in the rain with a photograph gone soft at the edges and nothing else. The sergeant wrote him down as Private and pointed at the mud.
Isidor Jackmdunn was among the first hundred through the depot gates. The First Wave ribbon is the only clean thing he owns.
Isidor Jackmdunn asked to leave the riflemans and serve as a machine gunner. The sergeant looked at him for a long time, then signed the paper without a word.
A flare lit Blackwater Canal like noon. Isidor Jackmdunn counted the seconds until darkness: eleven.

Felix Szymanski of the Hegemony threw a tin of tobacco into the Concord trench with a note: "for the one who sings". Isidor Jackmdunn kept the tin. Word came down the line: Verdel Ridge is ours. Isidor Jackmdunn shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.
Isidor Jackmdunn fired at a movement across the wire at S-F11. The man went down: Edmund Somosmagios, badly wounded.

A burst of machine-gun fire caught Isidor Jackmdunn in the open at S-F11. The tourniquet held. Whether he holds is another matter. Shot by Norbert Fransinlak of the Hegemony (@fransinlak). Isidor Jackmdunn looked over the parapet at S-F11 for one second too long. The bullet came before the sound. Shot by Norbert Fransinlak of the Hegemony (@fransinlak).

A letter came with Marek Jackmdunn: "I am Isidor Jackmdunn's older brother. I have come to finish what he started." Nobody had the heart to tell him it never finishes. Volunteer number 26. The quartermaster pinned the First Wave ribbon on Marek Jackmdunn's tunic and said: 'Don't let the mud have it.'

Oskar Pbscn cut Marek Jackmdunn's hair with a bayonet and a cracked mirror. It is not good. It is, however, short. Hill 304 is in Hegemony hands. Marek Jackmdunn stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
A muddy dog crawled into S-F11 through the wire. Marek Jackmdunn gave it half his bread. It has not left his side since. The men call it Biscuit.
jakub.prokes: After 3 days of war, S-F1 had a place for everything. On Day 4, the men rearranged a shelf to make a place for Albin Prokes.

Albin Prokes (Hegemony) shouted a challenge across to Otto "Saint" Kamdensipple (Concord) at the Sunken Road. The answer was lost under the guns. Nobody repeated the challenge. Mail came up the line with a letter for Albin Prokes. Albin Prokes read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. A bullet clipped Albin Prokes's helmet at S-F1 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Mail came up the line with a letter for Albin Prokes. Albin Prokes read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. Hill 304 is in Hegemony hands. Albin Prokes watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.

Albin Prokes no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt. Mail came up the line with a letter for Albin Prokes. Albin Prokes read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
wolfmanantony: Nils Wolfmananton came from Northwick, where there is a river, a church and no mud at all. He talks about all three as if they were people.
A bullet went through Nils Wolfmananton's sleeve at S-F8 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Dorian "Whistle" Csllgaks of the Concord (@csllgaks).

The medics cleaned Nils Wolfmananton's wound one last time and pronounced him fit. He is back to full duty at S-F8. The Concord hold Verdel Ridge now, and they can see straight into S-F8. Nils Wolfmananton has learned to walk bent double.

A direct hit on the trench at S-F8. Nils Wolfmananton was the only one they could still help, and only just. Nils Wolfmananton died in the hospital bed despite everything the surgeon tried. a rosary of rough beads was in his hand at the end.
Yann "Smokes" Wolfmananton arrived carrying the family name of Nils Wolfmananton. The corporal asked how to pronounce his first name, and waited for the answer.

The blast lifted Yann "Smokes" Wolfmananton off his feet at S-F8. He came round with a bloody nose and an empty rifle and went back to work. Mail came up the line with a letter for Yann "Smokes" Wolfmananton. Yann "Smokes" Wolfmananton read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Yann "Smokes" Wolfmananton sat out the day with a bandaged arm, cleaning every rifle within reach. It was the only job the medic would allow. Mail came up the line with a letter for Yann "Smokes" Wolfmananton. Yann "Smokes" Wolfmananton read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. The Hegemony flag went up over Hill 304. Yann "Smokes" Wolfmananton did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.

A bullet found Yann "Smokes" Wolfmananton at S-F8, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Shot by Zeno "Shadow" Maximus of the Concord (@sleetius_maximus). Yann "Smokes" Wolfmananton died on a stretcher outside the aid post, still waiting for a bed. The medics had nothing left to give him.
A letter came with Dietrich Wolfmananton: "I am Yann "Smokes" Wolfmananton's father. I have come to finish what he started." Nobody had the heart to tell him it never finishes.
